topLevelReturn.description: computeEvidenceGraph() returns a materialized evidence snapshot consumed by all coaching subsystems.

shape.evidence: { [topic: string]: L1EvidenceNode } — per-topic derived evidence keyed by topic name
shape.observations: L2Observations — threshold-gated factual observations across 7 categories
shape.clusters: WeaknessClusters — pre-computed trend clusters (passthrough from getWeaknessClusters())

L1_evidence.description: Per-topic derived evidence nodes. One node per topic from getTopicProgress(), merged with getTrends() data and the S131 EWMA time-weighted accuracy.

fields.description: Cumulative number of MCQ attempts for this topic across all sessions. Source: topicPerformance[topic].totalAttempts.
Cumulative number of correct MCQ answers for this topic. Source: topicPerformance[topic].correctCount.
Overall accuracy percentage: Math.round(correctCount / totalAttempts * 100). null if totalAttempts is 0.
Accuracy over the last 5 recent attempts (recentPct). null if no recent attempts. Source: topicPerformance[topic].recentPct.
EWMA accuracy with 14-day half-life. Weights each attempt by exp(-lambda * ageMs) where lambda = ln(2)/(14*24*3600*1000). null if no attempts exist. Rounded to integer 0-100.
Percentage of attempts where hints were used: Math.round(hintCount / totalAttempts * 100). Defaults to 0 if no attempts.
Weighted-average difficulty across all attempts: difficultyWeights.sum / difficultyWeights.total, rounded to 1 decimal place. null if no difficulty data.
ISO-8601 timestamp of the first encounter with this topic. Source: topicPerformance[topic].firstSeen.
ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent encounter with this topic. Source: topicPerformance[topic].lastSeen. Used by getEvidenceWindows() for recency categorization.

Run-based stability score (0-100). Computed as (1 - (runs-1)/(recentCorrects.length-1)) * 100 where runs counts transitions between correct/incorrect in recent attempts. Requires >=4 recent attempts. null otherwise. Source: getTrends().
Difference between recent accuracy and overall accuracy (recentPct - accuracy). Positive means improving. null if fewer than 2 total attempts. Source: getTrends().

Trend direction derived from delta. One of: 'improving' (delta >= 15), 'declining' (delta <= -15), 'slightly_improving' (delta > 5), 'slightly_declining' (delta < -5), or 'stable' (otherwise / default). Source: getTrends().
Direction of hint usage trend comparing last 5 vs older recent attempts. One of: 'decreasing', 'increasing', 'stable'. Source: getTrends().
Array of CMA Part 1 section letters (A-F) where this topic has been encountered. Empty array if unknown. Source: topicPerformance[topic].sectionsSeen.

Count of attempts per difficulty label. Keys are difficulty strings ('Easy', 'Moderate-Easy', 'Moderate', 'Difficult', 'Very Difficult'). Values are integer counts. Empty object if no data. Source: topicPerformance[topic].difficultyDistribution.

L2_observations.description: Threshold-gated factual observations derived from L1 evidence. Single source of truth for all learner classifications — no subsystem independently re-classifies data. Seven categories, two of which (calculationPatterns, terminologyPatterns) are initialized empty and reserved for future use.

strengths.threshold: >=3 totalAttempts, >=85% accuracy, direction is NOT 'declining' and NOT 'slightly_declining'

fields.description: Topic name.
Overall accuracy percentage.
Recent accuracy over last 5 attempts.
EWMA time-weighted accuracy (14-day half-life).
Total attempts for this topic.
Run-based stability score (0-100).
Canonical evidence tuple: { topic, accuracy, attempts, direction }.
Topic name.
Overall accuracy percentage.
Recent accuracy over last 5 attempts.
EWMA time-weighted accuracy (14-day half-life).
Total attempts for this topic.
Canonical evidence tuple: { topic, accuracy, attempts }.

misconceptions.threshold: >=2 occurrences of the same misconception pattern (p.count >= 2)

fields.description: Misconception pattern key. One of: 'misclassification', 'variance_sign_confusion', 'budget_component_error', 'cost_method_confusion', 'depreciation_method_error', 'cash_flow_classification', 'ratio_misapplication', 'control_framework_error', 'general_error'.
Number of occurrences of this misconception pattern.
Topics where this misconception has been observed (from _topics array in stored pattern).
ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent occurrence.
Canonical evidence tuple: { pattern, count, lastSeen }.

topicTrends.threshold: >=4 totalAttempts, delta is not null, |delta| >= 10 (improving if delta >= 10, declining if delta <= -10)

fields.description: Topic name.
Either 'improving' (delta >= 10) or 'declining' (delta <= -10).
Accuracy delta (recentPct - accuracy).
Overall accuracy percentage.
Recent accuracy over last 5 attempts.
Canonical evidence tuple: { topic, delta, attempts }.

calculationPatterns.description: Initialized as empty array []. Not populated by _deriveObservations(). Reserved for future calculation-error pattern detection.

terminologyPatterns.description: Initialized as empty array []. Not populated by _deriveObservations(). Reserved for future terminology-confusion pattern detection.

fields.description: Behavior trend label. One of: 'improving_topics', 'declining_topics', 'hint_dependent', 'difficulty_sensitive'.
Number of topics exhibiting this behavior trend.
List of topic names exhibiting this trend (mapped from cluster array).

L3_patterns.description: Multi-observation patterns that span topics or reveal higher-order structure. Derived from L2 observations and raw topic progress data.

types.threshold: Same misconception pattern appears across >=2 distinct topics

fields.description: Always 'cross_topic_misconception'.
The misconception pattern key shared across topics.
De-duplicated list of topic names where this pattern has been observed.
Sum of all occurrence counts across all topics for this pattern.
Reference to the merged misconception object: { pattern, topics, totalCount }.

types.threshold: >=3 sessions, >=5 totalAttempts, >=3 easy (Easy+Moderate-Easy) and >=2 hard (Difficult+Very Difficult) attempts in difficultyDistribution

fields.description: Always 'difficulty_amplification'.
Topic name exhibiting difficulty sensitivity.
Sum of 'Easy' + 'Moderate-Easy' counts from difficultyDistribution.
Sum of 'Difficult' + 'Very Difficult' counts from difficultyDistribution.
Canonical evidence tuple: { topic, easy, hard }.

L4_windows.description: Evidence aging categorization via getEvidenceWindows(). Partitions L1 evidence nodes by recency of lastSeen. Each window is { [topic: string]: L1EvidenceNode }.

archived.range: lastSeen more than 28 days ago, or never seen
archived.cutoff: remaining topics (lastSeen < historicalCutoff or lastSeen is falsy)

getFreshObservations.description: Filters L2 observations to only those whose evidence has not gone stale. Default max age is 28 days.

returnShape.strengths: L2Strength[] — strengths whose topic lastSeen >= cutoff
returnShape.weaknesses: L2Weakness[] — weaknesses whose topic lastSeen >= cutoff
returnShape.topicTrends: L2TopicTrend[] — topic trends whose topic lastSeen >= cutoff

verifyClassificationConsistency.description: Audits that L2 observations align with L1 evidence thresholds. Any mismatch is reported as a conflict.

returnShape.conflicts: Conflict[] — array of { topic: string, type: 'weak_classification'|'strong_classification'|'improving_classification', evidence: boolean, observation: boolean }

clusters.description: Pre-computed weakness clusters from getWeaknessClusters(). Passed through as-is in the top-level return. Used internally by _deriveObservations() for behaviorTrends and by coaching mode selection.

shape.persistentWeak: Trend[] — topics with accuracy<60 and totalAttempts>=5
shape.unstable: Trend[] — topics with stability<50 and totalAttempts>=4
shape.hintDependent: Trend[] — topics with accuracy>=70, hintTrend='increasing', totalAttempts>=4
shape.difficultySensitive: Trend[] — topics where lowPct-highPct>=0.3 (30pp gap), lowDiff>=2, highDiff>=2. Extended with lowPct and highPct fields.
